steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Finally, justice defeated evil. Super Lion defeated the beast, and purged this scourge from the city once and for all...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: How can it end like that? I don't want this ending!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: The ending of the story should be like this...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: After defeating Starzilla, Super Lion reaches out to it again.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: "Will you be my friend once more, and guard the city together with me?"

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But the real ending should be that Super Lion destroyed the beast...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: No no no! My ending is better! Super Lion and Starzilla are still friends!
You notice the girl hugging the little critter in frustration, her eyes tearing up a bit.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Well, even though your ending is nicer... it might be really hard to achieve.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What's now a cute critter is destined to become a big, uncontrollable monster.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: By then, it'll be too late.
The girl in front of you falls into silence.
